test_extract_cluster_assignment_ddp: test the TestExtractClusterWorkflow class and its DDP feature extraction integration test
create_pretraining_config: create a pretraining Hydra configuration for quick_swav with synthetic data and FSDP settings
create_extract_features_config_head: create an extract features Hydra configuration with head weights from a checkpoint path
create_extract_features_config_trunk: create an extract features Hydra configuration with trunk-only layer features from a checkpoint path
merge_features: merge extracted feature chunks from a directory back into a single tensor for a given split and layer
load_extracted_features: load extracted features from disk with optional flattening using ExtractedFeaturesLoader.load_features
sample_extracted_features: sample a subset of extracted features from disk with optional flattening using ExtractedFeaturesLoader.sample_features
